title: Ikimazi cakiriwe mu mbabazi .
intro: Funga amaso maze wiyumvire ikiyaya kinini kandi kicereje aho ukwizera kugeragezwa gushika aho kugarukira. Ugiye guhura n’umuntu ukuyoboka kwiwe gutuje imbere y’itegeko ritashobora kwiyumvirwa kwahinduye umwanya w’ikigeragezo ikimenyetso c’ibihe bidahera c’ukugamburuka n’ikigongwe c’Imana.
clues: Ndibuka muri Korowani mu bihanganye n’ukwihangana gukomeye.
Nari hagati y’iyerekwa ryagerageza ukuyobokera itegeko rya Allah.
Babwiwe ivy’iyerekwa, ndavuga nti mukore nk’uko mwategetswe muzosanga ndi mu barwayi.
Narashizwe hasi kubera ikimazi, ariko Allah arahamagara ngo iyerekwa ryarangutse.
Allah yarancunguye n’ikimazi gikomeye, ansiga icubahiro mu mayaruka azoza.
Ndi Ismail, uwo na Ibrahim twashizeho imishinge y’Inzu Nyeranda, ivugwa iruhande ya Idris na Dhul-Kifl mu bagororotsi.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Guhamagara abapfuye ngo basubire kubaho ku ruhusha rwa Allah
Ikimazi categetswe be n’ukuyoboka n’umutima ukunze .
trial.answer: Ikimazi categetswe be n’ukuyoboka n’umutima ukunze .

location.answer: Impfizi y’intama nini yarungitswe ngo ibe incungu .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yakubiswe n’igisasu gikomeye kubera yanse ingamiya y’ingore .
Yashimagijwe mu bahanuzi bihanganye kandi bagororotse .
Yarohamye mu kiyaga mu gihe yariko akurikira abemera .
outcome.answer: Yashimagijwe mu bahanuzi bihanganye kandi bagororotse .

verse: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous. (21:86)
